label: Synthesized classical Chinese spatial harmony with modernist architectural rationalism
description: Drawing on classical Chinese aesthetic proportion and Song architectural manuals (Yingzao Fashi), Lin formulated a modern philosophy of structural honesty and urban heritage.
dialecticalTension: Reconciles classical Chinese spatial order with 20th-century architectural theory.

label: Continued first-generation Chinese women scholars’ East-West intellectual synthesis
description: Following Chen Hengzhe’s pioneering academic path, Lin became one of China’s foremost public intellectuals bridging Western aesthetics and Chinese heritage.
dialecticalTension: Extends New Culture women’s scholarship into aesthetics and spatial philosophy.
